Age limits listed in the current DAAD scholarship database entry for the chosen funding duration

records.description: The DAAD Research Grants in Germany programme (bi-nationally controlled scholarships, funded by the Federal Foreign Office) awards research scholarships to highly qualified doctoral students and postdocs from all nationalities to carry out research stays at higher-education institutions and research institutions in Germany. Funding runs 2 to 12 months for doctoral students and 2 to 6 months for postdocs, at a monthly rate of 1,400 euros, supplemented by travel allowance, a research allowance of 460 euros for periods longer than six months, rent and family allowances where applicable, and DAAD-funded insurance.

not_confirmed: Exact application deadline for the 2027 round - the DAAD portal was closed ('Currently you cannot apply for this programme') and does not render a date for the upcoming cycle
verification.notes: Verified on the official DAAD scholarship database entry on 10 October 2026: 1,400 euro monthly research scholarship, 2-12 months (doctoral, up to and including year of defence) and 2-6 months (postdocs), travel allowance, research allowance of 460 euros for funding periods over six months, rent subsidy and family supplements, DAAD-funded insurance, funding must begin in 2027. Deadline recorded as null because the page does not display the upcoming deadline while the portal is closed.

records.applicant_utility: Applicant utility (original writing for the DAAD Research Grants in Germany): this grant suits the stage where you already have a project and need a host, not the stage where you are looking for a full PhD position - doctoral students can fund 2 to 12 months and postdocs 2 to 6 months in Germany, at 1,400 euros per month. Build the application backwards from a named supervisor or research group willing to host you, because supervision in Germany is part of what the evaluation reads. Mind the funding calendar: support must begin in 2027, and the portal opens and closes on the DAAD's annual round, so check the database entry regularly once the next cycle is announced. Six months is a financially meaningful threshold: the 460 euro research allowance only applies when funding runs longer than six months, so shape the stay to at least that length where scientifically defensible. Bring your language evidence and insurance documents in order, and remember the DAAD group insurance replaces the usual family accompaniment problem, so a longer stay is more realistic here than under many short-visit schemes.

records.programme_name: DAAD University Summer Courses - Language courses students and academics (HSK programme)
records.deadline_note: Applications are possible from 1 September each year until 30 October 2026 at 23:59 (CET); courses run between June and September.
records.application_cycle: Applications 1 September - 30 October 2026 (23:59 CET) annually, for courses between June and September
records.status_note: Applications for the summer course scholarship are possible from 1 September until 30 October 2026, 23:59 CET. Courses run between June and September, and nomination by a teacher or professor is required.
records.duration: 4-week specialist German language summer course between June and September
benefits: Course costs paid for a 4-week German language summer course
Travel allowance, accommodation contribution and insurance contribution
Courses taught by state-recognised higher education institutions in Germany between June and September
eligibility: Undergraduates with at least two years of study, graduate students, PhD students, young academics at undergraduate level and postgraduate academics of any nationality

Career-relevant, study-related, specialisation-related German language summer courses are funded; courses from other subject fields are eligible if their content is explicitly tied to career, study or specialisation

Up to 50 scholarships offered for applicants to attend specialist German language summer courses of at least 4 weeks at state-recognised German higher education institutions and summer schools, or equivalent courses offered at universities abroad by German teachers
Course dates and place of residence are not restricted
requirements: Nomination by a teacher or professor, with the completed nomination form
Online application with contact details, CV, email address and place of residence
Details of the immediate career purpose of the German study and study/training phase, referencing teachers or professors who know the applicant's German proficiency
Nature, length and proof of type of German education at school and at the institution
documents: Completed and signed nomination form (nomination by a teacher or professor)
Application documents per the DAAD portal for the chosen summer course
selection_criteria: Relevance of the summer course to career, study or specialisation
German language learning goals as documented in the file and nomination
records.citizenship_residency: Open to any nationality; no restriction on course dates and place of residence
records.international_eligibility: Students and academics of any nationality are eligible
records.subject_or_agency_requirement: German language summer courses (specialist courses) at state-recognised German higher education institutions
application_method: Applications via the DAAD portal from 1 September until 30 October 2026, 23:59 CET
Nomination by a teacher or professor is required
records.application_route: Obtain a nomination from a teacher or professor, complete the nomination form, and apply through the DAAD portal during the 1 September - 30 October window.
records.description: The DAAD University Summer Course programme offers up to 50 scholarships for undergraduates with at least two years of study, graduate students, PhD students, young academics and postgraduate academics of any nationality to attend specialist German language summer courses of at least four weeks at state-recognised higher education institutions and summer schools in Germany, or equivalent courses abroad taught by German teachers. The scholarship pays course costs, a one-time allowance of 475 euros, a travel allowance, an accommodation contribution and an insurance contribution.

verification.notes: Verified on the official DAAD scholarship database entry on 10 October 2026: one-time allowance of 475 euros, course costs, accommodation contribution, travel allowance and insurance contribution covered, applications possible from 1 September until 30 October 2026 at 23:59 CET, courses between June and September, nomination by a teacher or professor required, up to 50 scholarships, any nationality, minimum age 18.

records.applicant_utility: Applicant utility (original writing for the DAAD University Summer Courses HSK programme): this grant closes a single academic gap - German for a specific career or study purpose - in a single summer, and the whole award is small and self-contained: course costs plus a one-time allowance of 475 euros, a travel allowance, an accommodation contribution and an insurance contribution, for a course of at least four weeks between June and September. The eligibility profile is wide (undergraduates with at least two years of study, graduates, PhD students and young academics of any nationality, minimum age 18), so the differentiator is relevance: the file must show a career-relevant, study-related or specialisation-related German language purpose, and the nomination by a teacher or professor is mandatory. Start with the nomination, because without the completed form the application is incomplete, and choose the summer course early so your teacher can comment on your German learning goals in time for the 1 September - 30 October (23:59 CET) application window.
